name: answer_back_to_the_agent
title: Tasks · an agent made on call, and the answer to its question goes back to it

steps.say: keep a list of deals: the firm's name and the asking price
steps.reply:
I set up a **Deal list** in a new Deals module. It has two columns: the firm's name and the asking price. It's empty for now.

To add a deal, tell me something like "Acme Ltd, asking 2.5m". The price is stored as a plain number with no currency, so tell me if you want one set, like £ or $.
I added **Midwest HVAC** to your deal list at an asking price of 900,000. It's the first deal on the list. No currency is set yet, so tell me if you want one, like $ or £.

steps.say: make an agent called Deal Analyst that, when given a task about a deal, works it out from the deal's row, saves what it found on the row with its source, and asks me for anything the row doesn't have
steps.reply:
I made **Deal Analyst** in your Deals module. It doesn't run on a schedule. It only works when you give it a task.

When you give it a task, it will:
1. **Find the deal's row** by the firm's name. If it can't tell which deal you mean, it asks you.
2. **Work the task out** from what the row holds. It looks up public facts and names the source, and it never guesses.
3. **Save what it found on the row**, with where each value came from: a web address, "worked out from the row", or "estimated". If it needs a column that doesn't exist yet, it adds one. It never overwrites a value you entered yourse

steps.say: add a task on Midwest HVAC to ask the broker for 3 years of P&L, give it to the Deal Analyst and start it
steps.reply:
I added the task **"Ask the broker for 3 years of P&L"** to Midwest HVAC in your Deal list. It's assigned to the **Deal Analyst**, which has started and will begin within about half a minute. You can follow its progress on the task's page.

The deal's row only has the firm's name and the asking price, so it doesn't say who the broker is. The Deal Analyst will probably ask you for the broker's name and email. It also can't send anything on its own. Any message to the broker will come to you as a draft first, and nothing goes out until you approve it.
